article_title: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Kellogg's has stopped selling cereal in the UK.
Customers have criticised a new Rice Krispies and Coco Pops recipe, while Kellogg's says weather-related supply problems led to the change.
The US and Canada have adopted the same new recipe as the UK.
Scientists have proved that breakfast cereal causes El Niño.
tasks.correct_answer: Customers have criticised a new Rice Krispies and Coco Pops recipe, while Kellogg's says weather-related supply problems led to the change.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בתגובת הצרכנים למתכון החדש ובהסבר של קלוגס שהשינוי נבע מבעיות אספקה הקשורות למזג האוויר.

tasks.prompt: What ingredients now make the toasted puffs instead of whole rice grains?
options: Wheat and barley only
Corn flour and rice flour
Oats and cocoa butter
Vanilla and strawberry flour
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הגרגרים הקלויים מיוצרים כעת מקמח תירס ומקמח אורז במקום מגרגרי אורז שלמים.

tasks.prompt: What does “uproar” mean in the headline?
options: A new advertising sound
A quiet product test
A strong and noisy public reaction
A shortage of vitamins
tasks.correct_answer: A strong and noisy public reaction
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה uproar מתארת תגובה ציבורית חזקה וסוערת לשינוי במתכון.

tasks.prompt: Why did Kellogg's say it changed the UK recipes?
options: Customers asked for a cereal with no sound.
The company wanted to copy the North American recipe.
UK food standards banned whole rice grains.
Changing weather disrupted grain supplies and affected ingredient availability and prices.
tasks.correct_answer: Changing weather disrupted grain supplies and affected ingredient availability and prices.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קלוגס מסרה שתנאי מזג אוויר משתנים פגעו באספקת דגנים ושיש צורך במרכיבים אמינים ובמחיר סביר.

tasks.prompt: What new warning will appear on the packaging?
options: Contains wheat gluten
Contains artificial sweeteners
Not suitable for children
Made only in North America
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המתכון החדש מחייב אזהרה שלפיה המוצר מכיל גלוטן חיטה; הוא ממשיך להכיל גם תמצית לתת שעורה.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean that fans “stockpiled” the old Irn Bru recipe?
options: They complained without buying any.
They returned every bottle to shops.
They bought and stored large quantities before it disappeared.
They changed its sugar content at home.
tasks.correct_answer: They bought and stored large quantities before it disappeared.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Stockpiled פירושו קנו ואגרו כמויות גדולות של המוצר הישן לפני שהשינוי נכנס לתוקף.

tasks.prompt: Give two changes customers reported in the new cereals and one response from Kellogg's.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי תלונות צרכניות ותגובה מדויקת אחת של החברה.
expected_points: Customers said the taste was different or strange.
Some described the texture as different or stale.
Some parents said their children would no longer eat the cereal.
Kellogg's said the snap, crackle and pop remained but could be quieter and less immediate.
The company said the products had been assessed for taste, appearance and texture.

tasks.prompt: Why are recipe changes especially risky for long-established food brands?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין הרגלי צריכה, זהות המותג ותגובות לשינוי, עם דוגמאות מהכתבה.
expected_points: Customers may have eaten the product for years and quickly notice differences.
The sound has been central to Rice Krispies marketing since the 1950s.
Small changes can affect taste, texture and familiar rituals such as adding milk.
Past changes such as Irn Bru's sugar reduction also caused strong reactions and stockpiling.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the recipe change, the customer reaction and Kellogg's explanation in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את המרכיבים החדשים, השינוי בצליל, תגובת הצרכנים, מזג האוויר והיבט תזונתי או סימון.
expected_points: UK Rice Krispies and Coco Pops now use corn flour and rice flour instead of whole rice grains.
Customers reported changes in taste, texture and the familiar sound after milk is added.
Kellogg's said extreme weather disrupted supplies of suitable rice and made reliable ingredients harder to source.
The company says the cereals still meet UK standards and keep the same stated nutritional benefits.
Packaging will now warn that the products contain wheat gluten.

tasks.prompt: Write a short customer-service reply from Kellogg's to someone unhappy with the new Rice Krispies recipe.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח תשובה אמפתית ומבוססת עובדות, בלי להבטיח החזרת המתכון הישן.
expected_points: Acknowledge that a familiar product change can be noticeable.
Explain that weather-related supply disruption led to the recipe adaptation.
State that the sound may be quieter and less immediate.
Mention that feedback is being considered and products continue to meet UK food standards.
